contextual_unread_records.diagnostic_model: Delete one consecutive block of five observed slots, in each of all221 possible positions, solely to inspect the declared220-coordinate frame. This is not an accepted historical deletion or a complete reading.
limits: The native225-slot stream is odd and cannot be paired under the standard cipher.
The literal source and header disagree by five slots; neither is silently corrected.
Even the illustrative frames retain numerous implausible symbols and an unresolved opening. Their appearance of DAM...FER, PFERDEN and POTI does not establish a unique frame or full message.
No candidate from this first part enters the catalog or plaintext-position counts.

optional_contextual_extension.assumption: Read the opaque BRTVE... suffix as BRIEF...OBUNDWEMDIESE, guided by German syntax and the following native third part. This adds substantial observed-coordinate changes and is not independently established.
optional_contextual_extension.limit: The resulting DIESE at the end of A2 and DIESE at the start of A3 are both retained. No repeated word is deleted to manufacture a seamless reading.

prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Sep19–21 key with original provenance.

limits: Only A2 and A3 are counted as source editions. A1 is complete literal context, without an accepted body reading.
Main A2 retains its opaque suffix, rather than replacing it with the much more costly contextual hypothesis.
All eight unresolved A3 reference positions and their full domains remain visible; no historical numerical labels are supplied.
Raw fixed-position totals measure algebraic domains, not historically correct or linguistically readable characters.
Exact encryption checks certify the stated editing costs and compatibility, not a unique historical plaintext.
